title: How does the 6-digit child invite code work?
content:
Each child profile gets a unique 6-digit code that links their device to your family account. Share it only with your child — anyone with the code can access that child's profile.

If a code stops working, a parent can regenerate it from Settings > Children > [child name] > Regenerate Code.

title: Why can't I see my child's completed chores?
content: Completed chores need parent approval before they count toward earnings. Check the Approvals tab on your parent dashboard — completed-but-unapproved chores show there first.
